description_en: Queries statistics of rules under a specified WAF protection module
description_zh: 查询指定的WAF防护功能模块下规则的统计数据
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-defense-rule-statistics --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqt0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --template-id 239136 --primary-key scene --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDefenseRuleStatistics

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the protection template to query.

This operation supports querying protection templates under the new Bot Management (bot_manager) and new Web Core Protection (waf_base) scenarios. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712643.html to query the protection scenario (DefenseScene) of a protection template
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的防护模板ID。

本接口支持查询新版 BOT 管理（bot_manager）和新版 Web 核心防护（waf_base）防护场景下的防护模板。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2712643.html接口查询防护模板的防护场景（DefenseScene）
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The secondary query condition. The value cannot be the same as the primary query condition
parameters.help_zh: 二级查询条件，传入的值不能跟一级查询条件相同
parameters.name: secondary_key

parameters.help_en: The tertiary query condition. The value cannot be the same as the primary or secondary query condition
parameters.help_zh: 三级查询条件，传入的值不能跟一级、二级查询条件相同
parameters.name: third_key

parameters.help_en: The quaternary query condition. The value cannot be the same as the primary, secondary, or tertiary query condition
parameters.help_zh: 四级查询条件，传入的值不能跟一级、二级、三级查询条件相同
parameters.name: fourth_key

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Count.description_en: The number of rules that meet all query conditions
Count.description_zh: 同时满足查询条件的规则数量

FourthValue.description_en: The value corresponding to the quaternary query condition
FourthValue.description_zh: 四级查询条件对应的value值

PrimaryValue.description_en: The value corresponding to the primary query condition
PrimaryValue.description_zh: 一级查询条件对应的value值

SecondaryValue.description_en: The value corresponding to the secondary query condition
SecondaryValue.description_zh: 二级查询条件对应的value值

ThirdValue.description_en: The value corresponding to the tertiary query condition
ThirdValue.description_zh: 三级查询条件对应的value值
